homeInnerContentTitle: GGenius — a platform for MLBB players in Ukraine
homeInnerContentSub: Our platform helps Mobile Legends: Bang Bang players find a team, participate in tournaments, improve their game, and manage their profile — all through a convenient Telegram bot.
whatinnerSub: GGenius is a Telegram platform for MLBB players that combines everything you need for team play, competition, and skill development in one bot. Here you can:
whatinnerListItemSub1: GGenius helps you quickly find teammates to play with. Choose by age, role, play style, or language, and form a team for rankings and tournaments.
whatinnerListItemSub2: The platform offers tournaments of various formats, from local to amateur leagues. Choose one, register in a few clicks, and follow all the details on Telegram.
whatinnerListItemSub3: Want to host your own tournament? GGenius provides all the tools you need to organize it, from brackets to results and notifications.
whatinnerListItemSub4: AI analyzes your MLBB stats and gives personalized advice to improve your gameplay and rank.
workInnerSub: GGenius is Ukraine's first intelligent esports platform — available wherever you are. Run tournaments, level up with AI, and top up your diamond balance via the Telegram bot or directly on ggenius.gg. One account. One interface. The entire ecosystem.
workInnerListItemSubStart: Open @ggeniusgg_bot in Telegram or visit ggenius.gg and register in ~1 minute. The GPT-4o Vision-powered AI remembers your rank, favourite role, and playstyle — becoming your personal coach from day one.
workInnerListItemSubNext: Upload a match screenshot — AI instantly analyses your stats and recommends the best heroes, builds, and counterpicks. 131 heroes in the database, 6 roles, personalised analytics. Your profile and achievements are synced between the bot and the website in real time.
workInnerListItemSubEnd: Find teammates, join or create a team, register for a tournament with auto-brackets up to 64 teams — or instantly buy 💎 MLBB diamonds at direct prices. Pay via 💳 Monobank Acquiring, diamonds credited instantly, confirmation delivered to Telegram.
progressInnerMapListItemSub1: Platform launch: GPT-4o AI chat, player profiles, teammate search by rank / role / language / playstyle. 100+ organic registrations with zero marketing spend.
progressInnerMapListItemSub2: Full tournament module: auto-brackets up to 64 teams, hero ban system with Two-Stage Rendering, AI match commentator, Retina-quality match posters and ban cards. 160+ test tournaments completed on production infrastructure.
progressInnerMapListItemSub3: Launch of the ggenius.gg web platform with full bot sync. Opening of the 💎 Diamond Shop — MLBB diamond store with direct Monobank Acquiring integration. Ukraine's first legal MLBB micro-transactions without intermediaries.
progressInnerMapListItemSub4: Web dashboard for tournament organizers, Premium subscription with advanced AI analytics and custom banners, first public sponsored tournament with a prize pool, partner advertising in the News Engine.
progressInnerMapListItemSub5: Expansion to Poland and the Baltic states as the first fully automated platform for amateur and semi-professional esports. NFT hero card collectibles, mobile companion app, a custom fine-tuned LLM for MLBB.
partnersInnerContSub: The platform offers a variety of tournaments, from small local ones to large amateur leagues. Choose the format, review the rules, and register in just a few clicks. All the details — dates, lineups, brackets, and results — are collected directly in Telegram for maximum convenience.
